post_mortality_meat_diet.name: Labourers' Meat Diet
post_mortality_meat_diet.observation: With fewer mouths and dearer hands, labourers eat meat, cheese and wheaten bread that their grandparents saw only at feasts.
post_mortality_meat_diet.social_consequence: Lords grumble that ploughmen eat like yeomen, and new dress and diet laws try to keep servants to coarse bread and pottage.

estate_fishpond_chains.name: Carp Pond Chains
estate_fishpond_chains.observation: A chain of carp ponds on the estate is drained one by one; the fish go to market and the pond bed is sown for a year before it is flooded again.

rice_wheat_double_crop.name: Rice and Wheat Double Crop
rice_wheat_double_crop.observation: Wheat follows rice on the same field in the same year, and the valley feeds twice the people it did, at the cost of never resting.

town_hopped_brewhouses.name: Town Brewhouses
town_hopped_brewhouses.observation: Big town brewhouses make hopped beer that keeps for weeks, and it becomes the common drink at every table and workbench.

herring_buss_fleets.name: Herring Buss Fleets
herring_buss_fleets.observation: Decked ships stay out on the herring grounds for weeks, gutting and salting the catch on board as the drift nets come in.
herring_buss_fleets.social_consequence: The fishing towns grow rich on the herring; its seasons decide when sailors marry and when the town can pay its taxes.

famine_food_herbal.name: Famine Herbal
famine_food_herbal.observation: A herbal draws and describes the wild roots, leaves and seeds that are safe to eat when the harvest fails, and warns of those that kill.

sworn_cask_gaugers.name: Sworn Cask Gaugers
sworn_cask_gaugers.observation: Sworn gaugers measure every cask of wine and beer with a marked rod, and the town's duty is charged on their count.

grain_magistracy.name: Grain Magistracy
grain_magistracy.observation: The town's grain magistrates buy grain from distant ports in good years, keep it in the public stores and sell it at a fair price in dearth.
grain_magistracy.ability_reason: The town no longer waits on its own harvest: its officers buy grain from distant markets and sell it at a fair price when bread runs short.
grain_magistracy.social_consequence: The grain masters become the most watched men in town, and a rumour that they hoard can raise a mob at their doors.

marsh_fattened_cattle.name: Marsh-Fattened Oxen
marsh_fattened_cattle.observation: Lean oxen driven from the hills are fattened for a summer on rich marsh grass and sold to the town butchers.

island_cane_plantations.name: Island Cane Plantations
island_cane_plantations.observation: Cane is planted across newly settled ocean islands, crushed between rollers and boiled down, and sugar arrives by the shipload.
island_cane_plantations.ability_reason: Sugar leaves the apothecary's jar: roller mills on island plantations crush cane by the shipload, and sweetness becomes a trade good.
island_cane_plantations.social_consequence: The island estates are worked by bound and bought labour; their sugar sweetens the town while their fields become places of dread.

cheese_weigh_houses.name: Cheese Weigh-House
cheese_weigh_houses.observation: Every cheese and cask of butter for sale passes over the town's great scale, and the weigh-master's mark settles the price.

sworn_fish_packers.name: Sworn Fish Packers
sworn_fish_packers.observation: Sworn packers open each barrel of salt fish, repack the bad and burn the town's brand into the good.

printed_cookery_books.name: Printed Cookery Books
printed_cookery_books.observation: Cookery books are printed and sold to merchants' wives and innkeepers, and court dishes reach town kitchens.

printed_farm_manuals.name: Printed Farm Manuals
printed_farm_manuals.observation: Cheap farm manuals in the common tongue teach sowing, grafting and stock-keeping to any farmer who can read or knows someone who can.

maize_garden_trials.name: Maize Garden Trials
maize_garden_trials.observation: Seed brought across the ocean grows in herb gardens into tall grain with ears as long as a hand, and gardeners watch what it needs.
maize_garden_trials.ability_reason: Seed from the far shore of the ocean grows at home, and gardeners learn how tall, thirsty and generous the new grain is.

hop_drying_kilns.name: Hop Kilns
hop_drying_kilns.observation: Hops are dried on slatted floors over a slow fire in kilns built for the purpose, and keep their bite for a year.

distant_bank_salt_cod.name: Distant-Bank Salt Cod
distant_bank_salt_cod.observation: Fleets sail to far fishing banks each summer, split the cod on shore stages and dry it hard with salt and wind.
distant_bank_salt_cod.ability_reason: Cod dried hard on distant shores keeps for years, feeding fleets, armies and fast days far inland.
distant_bank_salt_cod.social_consequence: Whole coastal parishes empty of men each summer; widows' benches in the shrines fill when a fleet does not return.

chili_pepper_spread.name: Chili Peppers
chili_pepper_spread.observation: A red pod from across the ocean grows in any warm garden, and soon no cook's pot is without its heat.

sugar_fruit_pastes.name: Sugared Fruit Pastes
sugar_fruit_pastes.observation: Quinces and other fruit are boiled with sugar until the paste sets firm enough to cut and keep through the winter.

farmyard_turkeys.name: Farmyard Turkeys
farmyard_turkeys.observation: A large fowl brought across the ocean fattens in farmyards on scraps and is driven to town for feast days.

new_land_beans_squash.name: New-Land Beans and Squash
new_land_beans_squash.observation: Beans, squash and gourds from across the ocean crowd the kitchen gardens, cropping heavily where the old beans failed.

coffee_houses.name: Coffee Houses
coffee_houses.observation: Roasted beans are ground and brewed into a bitter black drink, and small houses serve it to men who sit for hours over news and bargains.
coffee_houses.ability_reason: A new bitter drink keeps men awake and talking; the coffee house becomes a place to trade news, cargoes and opinions.
coffee_houses.social_consequence: Rulers eye the coffee houses warily as nests of rumour, and more than one tries to close them and fails.

mulberry_dike_fishponds.name: Mulberry-Dyke Fishponds
mulberry_dike_fishponds.observation: Mulberry trees on the pond dykes feed silkworms, the worms' droppings feed the fish, and pond mud feeds the mulberries.

maize_field_crop.name: Maize Field Crop
maize_field_crop.observation: Maize is sown across whole fields in the warm lowlands and eaten as porridge and flat bread by the poor.
maize_field_crop.ability_reason: Maize returns more grain per seed than any old crop in warm lowlands, and porridge fills bowls where wheat failed.
maize_field_crop.social_consequence: Where the poor eat almost nothing but maize, a rough, peeling skin sickness follows the new crop.

potato_garden_curiosity.name: Potato Curiosity
potato_garden_curiosity.observation: A knobbly root from across the ocean is grown in botanists' gardens and boiled for guests as a curiosity.

hill_sweet_potato_maize.name: Hill Sweet Potato and Maize
hill_sweet_potato_maize.observation: Migrants clear the hills and plant sweet potato and maize where no rice would grow, and the slopes feed new villages.
hill_sweet_potato_maize.social_consequence: The cleared hills wash down into the valleys in heavy rain, and the lowland farmers blame the hill settlers.

cassava_cultivation.name: Cassava
cassava_cultivation.observation: Cassava roots are grated, soaked and pressed before cooking; they grow in poor soil and keep in the ground until needed.

convertible_husbandry.name: Convertible Husbandry
convertible_husbandry.observation: Fields are laid down to grass for several years and grazed, then ploughed up for grain, which comes up thick on the rested ground.
convertible_husbandry.ability_reason: Fields rested under grass for years return to grain rich again, and the grass years carry twice the stock.
convertible_husbandry.social_consequence: Farmers who rest land in grass need hedges and fences, and their open-field neighbours resent the enclosing.

bean_cake_fertilizer.name: Bean-Cake Fertilizer
bean_cake_fertilizer.observation: The cakes left after pressing oil from beans and seeds are broken up and spread on the fields, and are shipped by the boatload.

hotbed_forcing.name: Hotbeds and Glass Bells
hotbed_forcing.observation: Rotting dung under the beds and glass bells over the plants bring lettuce and melons to town weeks before their season.

groundnut_oil_crop.name: Groundnut Oil
groundnut_oil_crop.observation: Groundnuts from across the ocean grow on sandy land that grows little else, and are pressed for cooking oil.

court_chocolate_drink.name: Court Chocolate
court_chocolate_drink.observation: Cacao is ground, sweetened and whipped into a hot drink served to courtiers in the morning.
court_chocolate_drink.social_consequence: Chocolate becomes a mark of rank at court, and those not served it know where they stand.

lowland_export_dairying.name: Lowland Export Dairying
lowland_export_dairying.observation: Dairy farms on drained lowland grass send cheese and butter by the ship to other countries.

shipped_tea_trade.name: Shipped Tea
shipped_tea_trade.observation: Tea leaves come by ship from the far east in lined chests and are sold by weight to those who can afford them.

printed_grain_prices.name: Printed Grain Prices
printed_grain_prices.observation: Each week the market prices of wheat, rye and barley are printed and posted, and dealers far away read them.

town_luxury_vegetables.name: Town Luxury Vegetables
town_luxury_vegetables.observation: Market gardeners outside the walls grow cauliflower, artichokes and asparagus on heavily dunged beds for town tables.

cottage_potato_patches.name: Cottage Potato Patches
cottage_potato_patches.observation: Upland cottagers plant potatoes in lazy-beds by the door, and a small patch feeds a family through the winter.

bottled_strong_cider.name: Bottled Strong Cider
bottled_strong_cider.observation: Cider is bottled in thick dark glass and corked, and it matures sparkling and strong for a year or more.

clover_ley_fodder.name: Clover Leys
clover_ley_fodder.observation: Clover sown into the fallow feeds the stock, and the next grain crop on that ground stands thicker and greener.

seedsmen_named_varieties.name: Named Seed Varieties
seedsmen_named_varieties.observation: Seedsmen sell garden seed by the name of each kind, and a buyer knows what will come up.

field_turnips.name: Field Turnips
field_turnips.observation: Turnips sown in the open fields are hoed through summer and fed to cattle and sheep over the winter.
field_turnips.ability_reason: Turnips in the open field carry cattle through the winter, so fewer beasts are killed in autumn and the land gets their dung.

molasses_rum.name: Molasses Rum
molasses_rum.observation: The black molasses left from sugar boiling is fermented and distilled into a strong spirit for sailors and traders.

estate_ice_houses.name: Ice Houses
estate_ice_houses.observation: Ice cut from winter ponds is packed in straw in deep brick pits, and the great kitchens have ice all summer.

sainfoin_lucerne_hay.name: Sainfoin and Lucerne
sainfoin_lucerne_hay.observation: Sainfoin and lucerne sown on dry chalk and lime give heavy hay for years from land that once gave thin sheep grazing.

brewers_yeast_bread.name: Brewers' Yeast Bread
brewers_yeast_bread.observation: Bakers buy the froth from the brewhouse vats, and their bread rises lighter and more evenly than with old sour dough.

juniper_grain_spirit.name: Cheap Juniper Spirit
juniper_grain_spirit.observation: Grain spirit flavoured with juniper is distilled so cheap that a labourer can be drunk for a copper.
juniper_grain_spirit.social_consequence: Cheap spirit is sold in every cellar; mothers drink it, children are neglected, and preachers call it a plague.

stall_winter_fattening.name: Stall Fattening
stall_winter_fattening.observation: Cattle are kept in stalls through the winter on roots and hay and come out fat, and their dung is carted to the fields.

steam_bone_digester.name: Bone Digester
steam_bone_digester.observation: A sealed iron pot heated hard softens bones into jelly and broth, and nothing of the carcass is wasted.

grain_export_bounties.name: Grain Export Bounties
grain_export_bounties.observation: The treasury pays a bounty on every measure of grain shipped abroad when home prices fall below a set level.
grain_export_bounties.ability_reason: Paying farmers to export in cheap years keeps land under the plough, so there is more grain at home in dear years.
grain_export_bounties.social_consequence: Townspeople see grain loaded for abroad while bread is dear and riot at the quays.

fortified_voyage_wines.name: Fortified Wines
fortified_voyage_wines.observation: Wine laced with spirit keeps through a long voyage in a hot hold, and some say it comes back better than it left.

tomato_sauce_cookery.name: Tomato Sauces
tomato_sauce_cookery.observation: The red fruit from across the ocean, long thought dangerous, is cooked down into sauces and kept in jars.

sown_ryegrass_leys.name: Ryegrass Leys
sown_ryegrass_leys.observation: Ryegrass seed is sown for short leys of one or two years, and the grass comes up evenly instead of as hay-loft sweepings.

bottle_sparkling_wine.name: Sparkling Wine
bottle_sparkling_wine.observation: Wine sealed in strong bottles ferments a second time and foams when opened, and courts pay dearly for it.

coke_dried_pale_malt.name: Coke-Dried Pale Malt
coke_dried_pale_malt.observation: Malt dried over coked coal comes out pale and clean-tasting, and the maltsters no longer burn straw and wood.

coffee_plantations.name: Coffee Plantations
coffee_plantations.observation: Coffee is planted in rows on warm colonial hill estates, and the berries are dried and shipped home by the ton.
coffee_plantations.social_consequence: The estates are cleared from forest and worked by bound labour; the drink grows cheap at home and bitter abroad.

row_spacing_trials.name: Row Spacing Trials
row_spacing_trials.observation: Parallel strips sown at different spacings show how crowding, weeding and harvest trade against each other.

field_potato_crop.name: Field Potatoes
field_potato_crop.observation: Potatoes are planted by the acre in the open fields, and the poor live on them for much of the year.
field_potato_crop.ability_reason: An acre of potatoes feeds a family where an acre of grain fed only a few, and the poor can live on a patch.
field_potato_crop.social_consequence: Whole districts come to live on the one root, and a blighted year would leave them nothing else.

porter_vat_brewing.name: Porter
porter_vat_brewing.observation: Dark porter is aged for months in wooden vats as tall as houses, and the big brewers supply the whole town.

seed_drill.name: Seed Drill
seed_drill.observation: A horse-drawn drill drops seed in straight rows at an even depth and covers it behind.
seed_drill.ability_reason: Seed goes in at an even depth in straight rows, so less seed is wasted and the rows can be hoed.

light_swing_plough.name: Light Swing Plough
light_swing_plough.observation: A light plough with an iron share and a curved board is drawn by two horses and a single ploughman, not a team of oxen and boys.

horse_hoe_tillage.name: Horse Hoe
horse_hoe_tillage.observation: A horse hoe runs between the drilled rows, cutting weeds and loosening the soil in a day's work that took a gang a week.

household_sugared_tea.name: Daily Sugared Tea
household_sugared_tea.observation: Labouring households drink sweet tea with every meal, and the kettle is always on the hob.
household_sugared_tea.social_consequence: Labouring families spend on tea and sugar what once went on milk and ale, and moralists complain.

agricultural_improvement_societies.name: Agricultural Societies
agricultural_improvement_societies.observation: Landowners' societies award prizes for the best crops and stock and print the trials of their members for all to read.
agricultural_improvement_societies.ability_reason: Improving farmers compare their trials in print, and the best practice of one county becomes the practice of many.

sowing_depth_trials.name: Sowing Depth Trials
sowing_depth_trials.observation: Seed is sown at measured depths to find where it rises best in the local soil.

beet_sugar_discovery.name: Beet Sugar Found
beet_sugar_discovery.observation: A chemist boils down the juice of white beet and finds the same sugar that comes from cane.

field_carrot_cabbage_fodder.name: Field Carrots and Cabbages
field_carrot_cabbage_fodder.observation: Carrots and big cabbages are grown in the fields as cattle food and keep the milk flowing into winter.

tidal_rice_fields.name: Tidal Rice Fields
tidal_rice_fields.observation: Sluice gates let fresh river water flood the rice fields on the rising tide and drain them on the falling.
tidal_rice_fields.social_consequence: The tidal fields are fever country, and those who work them sicken and die young.

grain_bellows_ventilation.name: Ventilated Granaries
grain_bellows_ventilation.observation: Bellows blow air up through the stored grain, and it stays dry and sound for years instead of heating and souring.

spirit_licensing_duties.name: Spirit Licences
spirit_licensing_duties.observation: Cheap spirits are taxed heavily and only licensed sellers may sell them.

potato_planting_edict.name: Potato Planting Edict
potato_planting_edict.observation: Every district is ordered to plant potatoes against dearth, and officials hand out seed tubers.
potato_planting_edict.social_consequence: Peasants refuse a root they call pig food, and officials plant it under guard to make it seem worth stealing.

seedbed_firming.name: Seedbed Firming
seedbed_firming.observation: Seedbeds pressed firm with rollers after sowing hold the seed in the soil, and more of it comes up.

four_course_rotation.name: Four-Course Rotation
four_course_rotation.observation: Wheat, turnips, barley and clover follow one another on each field, and no field lies bare in any year.
four_course_rotation.ability_reason: No field lies bare: wheat, turnips, barley and clover follow each other, feeding both people and stock and building the soil.

pedigree_stock_breeding.name: Pedigree Breeding
pedigree_stock_breeding.observation: Breeders pair the best rams and bulls with their own close kin and keep books of the lines, fixing meat, wool and milk.
pedigree_stock_breeding.ability_reason: Stock bred by recorded lines grows heavier and more uniform, and a good sire's worth is known in advance.

voyage_keeping_foods.name: Voyage Keeping Foods
voyage_keeping_foods.observation: Casks of pickled cabbage and cakes of dried soup are stowed for long voyages, and sailors eat better far from land.

printed_farm_journals.name: Farm Journals
printed_farm_journals.observation: Monthly journals print farmers' letters, trials and prices, and a new method is read about across the realm within a season.

free_grain_trade_edict.name: Free Grain Trade Edict
free_grain_trade_edict.observation: The old limits on moving and selling grain are lifted, and grain goes wherever the price draws it.
free_grain_trade_edict.social_consequence: Prices float free; in a short year the poor riot for the old fixed price and pull grain carts from the road.

fodder_cutting_machines.name: Chaff Cutters
fodder_cutting_machines.observation: Hand-cranked machines chop straw into chaff and slice roots for the winter stalls.

brewing_thermometer.name: Brewing Thermometer
brewing_thermometer.observation: Brewers read the heat of the mash and the cooling wort on a glass thermometer, and fewer brews go sour.

yellow_turnip_mangold_roots.name: Mangolds and Yellow Turnips
yellow_turnip_mangold_roots.observation: Yellow turnips and mangolds stand the hard frosts that rot the white turnip, and keep in clamps until spring.

crushed_bone_manure.name: Bone Manure
crushed_bone_manure.observation: Bones from the town butchers are crushed in mills and spread on the fields, and turnips thrive on them.

brewers_saccharometer.name: Saccharometer
brewers_saccharometer.observation: A floating glass gauge measures how much sugar the wort holds, and brewers know their strength before they ferment.

threshing_machine.name: Threshing Machine
threshing_machine.observation: A drum driven by horses walking a ring or by a water wheel beats the grain from the straw.
threshing_machine.ability_reason: Grain is beaten out by horse or water power in days, not the whole winter; hands are freed and the crop is stored sooner.
threshing_machine.social_consequence: Winter threshing was the labourer's only paid work, and men burn the machines at night.

cast_iron_plough_parts.name: Cast-Iron Plough Parts
cast_iron_plough_parts.observation: Shares and mouldboards are cast in iron to a pattern, and a broken one is replaced from the ironmonger's stock.

public_soup_kitchens.name: Soup Kitchens
public_soup_kitchens.observation: In dear years soup kitchens ladle out cheap bone and barley soup to the poor by ticket.

agriculture_board_surveys.name: Board of Agriculture Surveys
agriculture_board_surveys.observation: A board of agriculture sends reporters to every district, and their printed surveys describe each county's farming.
agriculture_board_surveys.ability_reason: Every district's farming is written down, so good practice can be found, compared and spread.

closed_cooking_range.name: Closed Cooking Range
closed_cooking_range.observation: An iron range with an oven and a boiler encloses the kitchen fire, and cooks with half the fuel and less smoke.

sugar_beet_selection.name: Sugar Beet Selection
sugar_beet_selection.observation: Growers select white beet with the sweetest roots, year after year, to make sugar without the cane.
